protocol_type: Field-stream over a 4-bit multiplexed LAD[3:0] bus framed by LFRAME#; START + CYCTYPE+DIR + ADDR + SYNC + DATA, one nibble per LCLK.

start_field_encodings.name: FW_WRITE_OR_ABORT
start_field_encodings.purpose: Firmware Memory Write / Stop-Abort on LFRAME#

start_field_encodings.name: STOP_ABORT
start_field_encodings.purpose: Stop/abort code on LAD during LFRAME# low (reserved/firmware legacy)

sync_field_encodings.name: READY
sync_field_encodings.meaning: Data ready, no wait; transfer this cycle

sync_field_encodings.name: SHORT_WAIT
sync_field_encodings.meaning: Short wait sync; a few more cycles

sync_field_encodings.name: LONG_WAIT
sync_field_encodings.meaning: Long wait sync; many more cycles

sync_field_encodings.name: READY_MORE
sync_field_encodings.meaning: Ready with more DMA data to follow

turnaround: TAR is 2 LCLK cycles of bus float when LAD ownership reverses between host and peripheral
addressing: fixed platform-defined addresses; I/O 16-bit, Memory 32-bit, Firmware 28-bit + IDSEL
